title: OpenClaw
subtitle: // the AI agent that broke GitHub

sections.heading: The AI Agent Revolution
sections.body: OpenClaw is an open-source autonomous AI agent that runs on YOUR machine. It connects through WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and Discord — then takes real action. Shell commands, browser automation, email, files. Not a chatbot wrapper. An operator.

sections.heading: Why Agents Matter Now
sections.body: The fastest-growing open-source repo in GitHub history

sections.heading: Gateway Architecture
sections.body: A single Gateway process routes messages from any channel to the agent runtime. Channel adapters normalize input. A command queue serializes execution. Clean separation of concerns.

sections.heading: Your First Agent
sections.body: Three commands and you have a live agent on your phone.

codeSnippet.code:
# Install OpenClaw
curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install | bash

# Start the gateway
openclaw gateway start

# Connect WhatsApp
openclaw channel add whatsapp

# Send a message — your agent is live
# It can run shell commands, read files,
# browse the web, and manage your calendar

sections.heading: The Agent Loop
sections.body: OpenClaw runs a heartbeat — a scheduled loop where the agent wakes, checks tasks, acts, and sleeps. No prompt required. Time and state are first-class citizens.
bulletPoints: Memory persists as Markdown files on disk
Context window ≠ memory: tokens vs storage
12+ messaging channels as the UI layer

sections.heading: Agent Configuration
sections.body: Define agents in Markdown. No code needed. Each agent gets isolated workspace, model, tools, and channels.

codeSnippet.code:
# AGENTS.md

## Main Assistant
- model: claude-opus-4-6
- tools: [exec, web, files, calendar]
- memory: persistent
- channels: [whatsapp, telegram]

## Code Reviewer
- model: claude-sonnet-4-6
- tools: [exec, git, read]
- memory: session-only
- channels: [slack]

sections.heading: The Skills Ecosystem
sections.body: Skills are plug-and-play capabilities. 3,000+ community extensions shipped in the first three weeks. Browse ClawHub, click Install, and your agent gains new powers — from email triage to GitHub PR reviews.

sections.heading: Scheduled Automation
sections.body: Cron jobs and webhooks turn agents into proactive operators.

sections.heading: Channel Integration
sections.body: One agent across every messaging platform. The Gateway normalizes messages from any source into a unified format before the LLM ever sees them.
bulletPoints: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, iMessage
Canvas for live visual rendering in-chat

sections.heading: Multi-Agent Orchestration
sections.body: Scale beyond one agent. Each specialist gets an isolated workspace, its own credentials, and separate memory. A coordinator delegates tasks across the team.

sections.heading: Agent-to-Agent Messaging
sections.body: Agents communicate natively through peer sessions.

sections.heading: Security Reality Check
sections.body: An AI agent with root access is a double-edged sword. Cisco found 26% of 31,000 community skills contained at least one vulnerability. But OpenClaw stacks 6 defense layers.
bulletPoints: Docker sandbox with configurable workspace isolation
Skill Scanner for automated vulnerability detection

sections.heading: Production Deployment
sections.body: Docker Compose with rolling updates. Production-ready in 22 minutes on any VPS.

codeSnippet.code:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  openclaw:
    image: openclaw:latest
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        order: start-first
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    env_file: .env
    healthcheck:
      test: wget -qO- http://localhost:3000
      interval: 15s
      retries: 3
    restart: always

sections.heading: What Comes Next
sections.body: OpenClaw is now an independent foundation backed by OpenAI. Baidu embedded it for 700 million users. The roadmap includes native task queues, distributed multi-node deployments, and built-in Prometheus observability. We are shifting from tools we operate to systems we supervise.
